summary: LATAM Airlines Group S.A. filed a Form 6-K with its interim consolidated financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, containing standard financial statements and accounting policies. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is disclosed. The report is purely financial reporting by a foreign private issuer and does not trigger any special-situations classification.
